cards.t: Petrobras Tests Cardano for Fuel Tracking
cards.b: Brazil's state-owned oil giant Petrobras is utilizing Cardano in two research projects to trace sustainable aviation fuel and renewable diesel data, preventing dual-counting of emission benefits.

per.ADA: Enterprise-level adoption by a major South American multinational provides a fundamental validation catalyst.

cards.t: Kakaopay Explores Tokenizing Korean Equities with Ondo and Dinari
cards.b: Kakaopay Securities is actively collaborating with Dinari and Ondo Finance to explore bringing tokenized Korean-listed equities to global international markets.

per.ONDO: Positions ONDO directly at the center of institutional real-world asset (RWA) expansion into Asian equities.

cards.t: Bitwise Launches First U.S. Spot NEAR ETF
cards.b: Bitwise has rolled out the first U.S. spot NEAR ETF on NYSE Arca, capitalizing on a broader token rally and growing adoption of NEAR Intents.

per.NEAR: Wall Street ETF inclusion opens up traditional institutional capital inflow channels directly for the token.

cards.t: Bitget Hacker Moves Stolen Funds Into Zcash Privacy Pool
cards.b: Following a major security breach, the Bitget attacker has routed millions in stolen assets into Zcash's Ironwood privacy pool after facing rejections elsewhere.

per.ZEC: Brings heavy volume and intense focus back to Zcash's privacy features and decentralized utility.

cards.t: DogeOS Public Testnet Opens for Meme Coin Utility
cards.b: The MyDoge wallet team has opened a public testnet for DogeOS, a custom layer designed to allow developers to build lending markets and games directly on top of the network.

per.DOGE: Shifts narrative slightly from pure payment speculation toward fundamental application layer development.

cards.t: Standard Chartered Forecasts Massive USDe Scale and ENA Rally
cards.b: Standard Chartered issued a bullish long-term outlook predicting Ethena's USDe supply to reach $40 billion and ENA to scale higher alongside increased buybacks.

per.ENA: Institutional macroeconomic backing provides structural validation for forward-looking derivative traders.
